DeviceEntity.title: DeviceEntity
DeviceEntity.description: Registered Android device capable of acting as screen share host, remote controller, or dual-role peer.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the device owner.

deviceName.description: Human-readable model or custom name of the device.

pairingCode.description: 6-digit pairing code currently associated with this device.

roleMode.description: Active operational role mode of the device.

alwaysAllowControl.description: Whether trusted controllers can connect anytime without manual per-session approval.

screenShareActive.description: Whether the MediaProjection foreground service is currently active.

accessibilityActive.description: Whether the LinkMirror AccessibilityService is enabled for remote touch control.

trustedUids.description: Bounded list of Firebase Auth UIDs permitted to initiate remote sessions with this device.

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp of last device heartbeat (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when device was registered (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when device was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PairingRecord.title: PairingRecord
PairingRecord.description: Short-lived or persistent 6-digit pairing invitation linking a controller account to a host device.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the host device owner.

hostDeviceId.description: Document ID of the host device.

hostDeviceName.description: Display name of the host device.

controllerUid.description: UID of the controller user who claimed the code, or empty while OPEN.

controllerDeviceName.description: Device name of the claiming controller, or empty while OPEN.

alwaysAllow.description: Whether the host grants always-allow trusted access upon pairing.

RemoteSession.title: RemoteSession
RemoteSession.description: Real-time screen sharing and remote control session between two devices.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the host device owner.

hostDeviceId.description: Document ID of the host device.

hostDeviceName.description: Display name of the host device.

controllerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the controller.

controllerDeviceId.description: Document ID of the controller device.

controllerDeviceName.description: Display name of the controller device.

participantUids.description: Bounded list of participant UIDs (1 or 2 entries) for session isolation.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the remote session.

alwaysAllow.description: Whether anytime trusted access is authorized for this session.

remoteControlEnabled.description: Whether remote touch and gesture dispatch is enabled on the host.

latestFrameBase64.description: Latest compressed JPEG screen frame encoded in Base64.

frameWidth.description: Width of the streamed screen frame in pixels.

frameHeight.description: Height of the streamed screen frame in pixels.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last frame or status update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

RemoteCommand.title: RemoteCommand
RemoteCommand.description: Remote touch gesture or global navigation command dispatched from controller to host AccessibilityService.

senderUid.description: UID of the controller that issued the command.

hostUid.description: UID of the target host device.

participantUids.description: Denormalized participant UIDs matching parent session.

endNormX.description: Normalized horizontal end coordinate for swipes (0.0 to 1.0).

endNormY.description: Normalized vertical end coordinate for swipes (0.0 to 1.0).

status.description: Execution status updated by host AccessibilityService.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of command execution update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SharedPhoto.title: SharedPhoto
SharedPhoto.description: Shared gallery photo or captured screen snapshot exchanged between paired devices.

participantUids.description: Denormalized participant UIDs matching parent session.

imageBase64.description: Compressed JPEG image encoded in Base64.

/devices/{deviceId}.description: Registered devices owned by or trusted by the signed-in user.

/pairings/{pairingCode}.description: 6-digit pairing codes for cross-account trusted device authorization.

/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Active and historical screen sharing and remote control sessions.

/sessions/{sessionId}/commands/{commandI.description: Remote gesture and global action command queue for a session.

/sessions/{sessionId}/sharedPhotos/{phot.description: Photos and screen snapshots shared during a session.
